points.title: 法老
points.description: 拉美西斯二世在位初期，积极扩张埃及领土，加强中央集权。
points.descriptionEn: Ramses II began his reign by expanding Egyptian territory and strengthening central authority.

points.title: 法老
points.description: 拉美西斯二世的鼎盛时期，他领导埃及进行多次军事远征，并建造了众多神庙和雕像。
points.descriptionEn: In the prime of his reign, Ramses II led numerous military campaigns and constructed numerous temples and statues.

points.title: 法老
points.description: 拉美西斯二世晚年，可能卒于此年，埃及开始进入一段政治动荡期。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, possibly dying in this year, Ramses II saw Egypt enter a period of political turmoil.

supporter.zh: 拉美西斯二世是埃及历史上最伟大的法老之一，他的统治时期被认为是埃及的黄金时代。
supporter.en: Ramses II is considered one of the greatest pharaohs in Egyptian history, with his reign being regarded as the golden age of Egypt.

critic.zh: 一些历史学家批评他的军事扩张导致埃及国力过度消耗，为后来的衰落埋下了隐患。
critic.en: Some historians criticize his military expansion for overextending Egypt's resources and laying the groundwork for later decline.

objective.zh: 拉美西斯二世在位期间，埃及达到了政治、经济和文化的顶峰，但他的统治也伴随着军事扩张的代价。
objective.en: During his reign, Egypt reached the peak of its political, economic, and cultural power, but his rule also came with the cost of military expansion.

self.en: I wish to be the eternal symbol.

others.zh: 拉美西斯二世是埃及的骄傲。
others.en: Ramses II is the pride of Egypt.
